description: RedCap-owned Feishu notification policy. Only the single reachable lark-cli profile is allowed, and notifications are limited to node reports or human-intervention interrupts.
node_report_rule: Use exactly one node-report notification for a human-visible closeout/status node; do not open a background followup watcher.
manual_intervention_rule: Use manual-intervention only when RedCap must interrupt because the user needs to make a decision or unblock the task.
routine_success_rule: SessionEnd success notifications are disabled by default; on-complete owns the final node-report notification.
